inputs.text: The IOC has finally put fairness and safety ahead of ideological pressure: transgender women and DSD athletes will be excluded from the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games. Women’s sport exists to protect a fair category for female competitors, not to erase the distinction for political fashion. Kirsty Coventry put it plainly: “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category.” This is a necessary defense of women’s opportunity and the integrity of competition.
